Looks: 0 of 17 passes read since 2025-01-01 are candidates; EMIT looked 29 times in all.
Record: TROPOMI tipped this site from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-18; the latest fine-scale confirmation is a Carbon Mapper plume on 2026-08-26, 40 days earlier; EMIT last looked on 2026-08-19 (within noise).
Recommendation: no new fine-scale look needed, because the latest confirmation is within 90 days of the tip.
